glossary.scope: As used in sections 1345.41 to 1345.50 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Purchase price" means the total cumulative price of a prepaid entertainment service, whether under single or multiple contracts, including all interest and service charges.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1345.41 to 1345.50 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Business day" means any calendar day except Sunday, or a legal holiday as defined in section 1.14 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1345.41 to 1345.50 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "First service" means the first service rendered to the buyer under a prepaid entertainment contract that is typical of the type of service rendered throughout the course of the contract and that is not a special or an introductory service.
